title: Tree Parking
statementMd:
Consider the following problem statement:

- You are given a tree with $n$ vertices rooted at $1$. For each $1 \leq i \leq n$, a car will enter the root at time $l_i$. It will then instantaneously travel from the root to vertex $i$ through the unique simple path and park there. It will leave through the same path in the other direction at time $r_i$.During the time when a car is parked in a vertex, it blocks other cars from traveling through that vertex. The tree is called *valid* if and only if all cars are able to enter and leave the tree at their desired times.Count the number of pairs of sequences $l$, $r$ such that $l_i \lt r_i$, their concatenation is a permutation of $1 \ldots 2n$, and the tree is valid.

Calculate the sum of the answers to the problem over all labeled trees$^{\text{∗}}$ with $n$ vertices and $k$ leaves. The root is not considered a leaf. Since the answer may be large, calculate it modulo $998\,244\,353$.

$^{\text{∗}}$Two labeled trees are considered different if and only if their edge sets are different.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The only line of each test case contains two integers $n$, $k$ ($1 \leq k \lt n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the number of vertices and leaves of the tree, respectively.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output one integer — the answer modulo $998\,244\,353$.

## Note

In the first case, there is only one tree that satisfies the constraints. The correct pairs of sequences are: $$ (l, r) = \bigl([1, 3], [2, 4]\bigr),\:\bigl([3, 1], [4, 2]\bigr),\:\bigl([2, 1], [3, 4]\bigr). $$
statementZhMd:
考虑以下问题：

- 给你一棵以 $1$ 为根、共有 $n$ 个顶点的树。对于每个 $1 \leq i \leq n$，一辆汽车将在时刻 $l_i$ 驶入根，随后沿唯一的简单路径瞬间从根行驶到顶点 $i$ 并停放在那里，再于时刻 $r_i$ 沿同一路径反向驶离。当一辆汽车停放在某个顶点时，它会阻挡其他汽车通过该顶点。当且仅当所有汽车都能在各自期望的时刻进入并离开树时，这棵树被称为*合法的*。统计满足以下条件的序列对 $l$, $r$ 的数量：$l_i \lt r_i$，将二者拼接后是 $1 \ldots 2n$ 的一个排列，且这棵树是合法的。

对于所有具有 $n$ 个顶点和 $k$ 个叶子的带标号树$^{\text{∗}}$，计算上述问题答案的总和。根不算作叶子。由于答案可能很大，请对 $998\,244\,353$ 取模。

$^{\text{∗}}$当且仅当两棵带标号树的边集不同时，它们被视为不同的树。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例仅包含一行，含两个整数 $n$, $k$（$1 \leq k \lt n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$）——分别表示树的顶点数和叶子数。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——答案对 $998\,244\,353$ 取模的结果。

## 说明

在第一个用例中，只有一棵满足约束条件的树。正确的序列对为：$$ (l, r) = \bigl([1, 3], [2, 4]\bigr),\:\bigl([3, 1], [4, 2]\bigr),\:\bigl([2, 1], [3, 4]\bigr). $$
